title: The Lost Summit
author: Oscar Dunmore
blurb: Beatrix Dunmore, a storm chaser who owes money to dangerous optimists, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help before the concession permits expire.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
